name: forly-intake-server
description: Standalone intake server for the nadlan demo: serves the agent forms, accepts photo uploads to local disk with public URLs, creates listings, and kicks the n8n WW1 pipeline. No Firebase Functions or emulator involved.
//: PAGE OWNERSHIP (PAGE_UPDATE_AUTH)
POST /api/page/update is owner-only: the session phone must match the
page's business_phone, or be listed in ADMIN_PHONES. It previously
accepted any caller, so anyone holding a page_id could rewrite a page.
Deploy it once with PAGE_UPDATE_AUTH=log to find any caller we don't know
about — denials are logged as 'page_update_denied ...' but still allowed
through. When the log stays clean, REMOVE the var: anything other than
'log' enforces, so enforcing is the default and opening it is deliberate.
Unaffected: /api/page/edit-text, which authenticates with the per-page
edit_token and serves agents who are not logged in.
RUNNING TESTS
npm test      -> pure unit tests, no network, no npm install needed
RUNNING LOCALLY
npm run local          -> http://127.0.0.1:8787
Fine for anything you drive yourself with curl, e.g. testing the stitch:
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8787/api/video-overlay -H 'content-type: application/json' \
-d '{"video_urls":["<clip0>","<clip1>"],"lines":["כותרת"]}'
RUNNING LOCALLY AGAINST n8n
n8n lives on n8n.srv1173890.hstgr.cloud and cannot reach your localhost,
so the dev server is published at a PERMANENT public hostname:
https://dev.srv1173890.hstgr.cloud
It never changes. Configure the 'Stitch And Overlay Titles' node in WW1
Walkthrough V2 to https://dev.srv1173890.hstgr.cloud/api/video-overlay
ONCE and leave it there — no more putting it back afterwards.
npm run dev
That starts the tunnel and the server together, and stops the tunnel
when you ^C — so a stale forward never keeps holding port 8788 on the
VPS and blocking the next reconnect. `npm run local` still runs the
server alone, reachable only on 127.0.0.1:8787.
The tunnel binds the VPS docker bridge gateway, which npm run dev
defaults to 172.18.0.1. If root_default is ever recreated, re-read it:
docker network inspect root_default -f '{{(index .IPAM.Config 0).Gateway}}'
and run  BRIDGE_GW=<addr> npm run dev.
with these in your environment:
BASE_URL=https://dev.srv1173890.hstgr.cloud
REMOTE_UPLOAD_BASE=https://staging.srv1173890.hstgr.cloud
PAGE_BASE_URL=https://staging.srv1173890.hstgr.cloud
ALLOW_INFRA_PAGE_BASE=1
NADLAN_JWT_SECRET=<the same value staging uses>
BASE_URL must be the PUBLIC url, not localhost: /api/video-overlay builds
the video_url it returns from BASE_URL and GreenAPI fetches that URL.
Point it at 127.0.0.1 and the stitch succeeds while WhatsApp delivery
fails.
REMOTE_UPLOAD_BASE is what keeps a page you build here working after you
shut the laptop. Media URLs are absolute and are stored in Firestore at
build time, so anything stamped with a host that later goes away is dead
in the row forever — that is how the old throwaway tunnels left broken
images and videos on pages prod still serves. With it set, the bytes are
relayed to always-on staging and the stored URL is a staging URL. It only
takes effect when NADLAN_JWT_SECRET matches staging's; otherwise the relay
turns itself off and says so on boot.
Nothing is reachable while the laptop is off — that is what staging is
for: https://staging.srv1173890.hstgr.cloud, deployed from the `staging`
branch by .github/workflows/deploy-staging.yml.
First time? docs/dev-staging-setup.md is the step-by-step setup, with
the sshd change, the keys, staging.env and the verification commands.
A full end-to-end run also wants FAL_KEY (music bed) and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
(room labels) in the environment; without them the video still renders,
silent and/or unlabelled, and says why in music_debug / room_debug.
Needs ffmpeg with libass plus a Hebrew font on PATH, or Hebrew titles come
out as tofu boxes. No local ffmpeg? Use the image instead, which already
has both — from the repo root:
docker build -f server/Dockerfile -t forly-intake .
docker run --rm -p 8787:8787 -e BASE_URL=https://dev.srv1173890.hstgr.cloud forly-intake
